headline: Learned models pair sequence design with structure, surfaces, and affinity guidance
label: Structure Conditioned Generative Design
summary: Recent preprints and one published study pair learned generators with structure, conformation, and affinity information.
synthesis: The dominant thread is conditioning learned generative or predictive models on explicit structural, surface, conformational, or energetic information. EnzyPGM co-generates enzymes and substrate-binding pockets through residue-atom attention, and MuCO separates backbone design, side-chain packing, and all-atom optimization for cyclic peptides. ProChoreo aligns sequences with MD-derived conformational ensembles via contrastive learning to condition an autoregressive binder generator. Surf2Spot fuses sequence embeddings with structure and surface properties to predict hotspots, and the KAN-based positive-unlabeled pipeline couples PPI-score-guided Monte Carlo sequence generation with a learned classifier. BADGER adds binding-affinity guidance to diffusion models for structure-based drug design. What is new is the explicit pairing of learned sequence or chemical representations with geometry, surfaces, conformational dynamics, and affinity guidance within generative design pipelines.
